title: LOOKUPVALUE returns the alternate result when only some of the search pairs match
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", LOOKUPVALUE ( Product[Product], Product[Color], "Green", Product[Category], "Accessories", "none" ) )

source.quote: If no match satisfies all the search values, the function returns BLANK or alternateResult (if specified)
source.supports: no value when only some criteria match; the alternate result is returned if given

source.quote: In case LOOKUPVALUE does not find a suitable matching row, it returns the default value
source.supports: the last unpaired argument is the default

derivation: The only Green product is Scooter, category Vehicles. No row is both Green and Accessories, so the alternate result "none" is returned.
